implementation_notes: For clinician review before release; never use questionnaire alone to create a treatment plan.
This is a prototype, not a HIPAA-compliant deployment. Store submissions only on an authorized secure backend.
Consent choices must be logged with timestamp, notice version, patient identity and recipient, and be revocable.
Use authenticated portal or approved encrypted delivery where possible; verify recipient addresses before sending.
Use validated clinical screening instruments if collecting scores or triggering clinical decisions.
Provide an emergency-symptom escalation pathway and accessible alternatives.
